endpoint: Construct one strict Kummer class outside the marked generic M17 subgroup by principalizing the square of an equation-defined good-prime half ideal.
inputs: Only the E302 cubic, complete S, maximal-order data and generic Kummer classes from the frozen constructor arithmetic. The M24/public point data are forbidden until a later post-construction validator.
method: Take the first twenty rational good primes admitting a degree-one prime of K and choose its first deterministic prime ideal. Enumerate every nonempty subset J in binary-mask order. Test I=J^2 using PARI idealred; I is accepted only when its reduced ideal is O_K and the returned multiplier verifies I=(alpha). Reject rational-square classes. Impose the exact strict local condition after a generic correction and require a fixed good-prime character outside the generic span.
verification: Each reported candidate carries the exact half ideal, its square, the principal generator, norm-square check, all strict local signatures, generic correction and an independent fixed-good-prime character witness. A relation or a strict class is not a rational point; only a later cover solver and an M24 post-hoc validator may prove rank growth.
failure_semantics: Completion without a candidate closes only this finite deterministic half-ideal family. It is not a class-group computation, class-group bound, Selmer bound, Sha statement, or rank conclusion.
